name: Yutaka / Jean
source:
A member of "Thieves' Empire".

[url=/c7373]Arsène[/url]'s (and [url=/c7388]Cagliostro[/url]'s) butler who has an androgynous appearance. According to Arsène, Yutaka is in the same grade as [url=/c7377]Rat[/url].
